DSC 4000/6000/8000/8500 Comprehensive Solutions for Differential Scanning Calorimetry
Product catalog summary
Introduction to Thermal Analysis Solutions
PerkinElmer has introduced a new line of high-performance Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) solutions aimed at enhancing thermal analysis capabilities across various applications such as quality assurance, polymer and pharmaceutical research, and product development.
DSC Models Overview
DSC 4000: A reliable, single-furnace solution for routine materials characterization, featuring an optional 45-position autosampler and upgradeability to the DSC 6000. It offers fast measurements, integrated mass flow control, and a portable cooling device.
DSC 6000: Builds on the DSC 4000 with Modulated Temperature DSC (MT-DSC) technology for improved data interpretation, suitable for advanced materials research.
DSC 8000: Features double-furnace technology for precise energy measurements, with high sensitivity and reproducibility, ideal for isothermal kinetics studies and UV curing in polymers.
DSC 8500: Incorporates second-generation HyperDSC® technology for high accuracy and sensitivity, supporting fast scanning rates and in-situ ballistic cooling, suitable for process simulation and polymorph characterization in pharmaceuticals.
Technological Innovations
Double-Furnace Technology: Utilizes two independent furnaces for more accurate heat flow measurements and faster response times.
Application Capabilities: Highlights include UV curing of polymers, polymorph characterization in pharmaceuticals, and isothermal crystallization studies of polymers.
Additional Features
Optional autosamplers and a range of cooling accessories enhance DSC performance. The Pyris software platform supports data acquisition, analysis, and reporting for both routine testing and advanced research.
Historical Context and Innovation Timeline
Celebrating 50 years since the invention of DSC, the document outlines the evolution of PerkinElmer's DSC instruments, from the first model in 1963 to advanced models like the DSC 8000 and 8500, including milestones such as the first computer-controlled DSC.
Service and Support
PerkinElmer offers extensive service and support with over 1300 service engineers worldwide, providing on-demand repairs, preventive maintenance, training, and custom qualification documentation.
Applications and Testimonials
DSC is used across various applications, with testimonials highlighting its ability to measure difficult transitions and its superior resolution and accuracy for heat capacity measurements.
Conclusion
PerkinElmer positions itself as a leader in thermal analysis, offering a wide range of instruments and applications, encouraging exploration of new opportunities with their innovative solutions.

The double-furnace difference By providing two independent, low-mass furnaces, our double-furnace technology enables you to directly measure the heat flow change of your sample. And that means more accurate measurements over the whole temperature range, as well as rapid response time.
How does it work? Sample and reference materials are placed in different furnaces. A closed loop system adjusts the power to the sample furnace equal to the endothermic or exothermic behavior of the sample.
